data.app_name: The Pirate Queen with Lucy Liu
data.description:
Embark on an epic journey through the turbulent waters of history in "The Pirate Queen", with Lucy Liu 🌟

![{"height":224,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-lhr6-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38982662_7513468888773292_7586277367396825871_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=20e1pVcWi5EQ7kNvgFa0rFv&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-lhr6-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYDXchXvfYLr0q7PD5WBrGp48P4j7bbYBTMXxqYgSuQfCg&oe=6728B09C)

Step into the boots of the legendary pirate Cheng Shih and see if you have what it takes to become history's most powerful pirate  🏴‍☠️


![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-lhr8-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39036653_1456869748359051_7076517034930849202_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=1-PYldygKlwQ7kNvgGW2871&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-lhr8-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAzrOcwE4Z_RGc-zhFfT_oVG55NXsyY9EffhsuBFcFxCA&oe=6728BA24)


Travel back in time with this immersive story, perfect for explorers of all ages. Whether you're seeking a fresh adventure, yearning to escape into another world, or eager to unearth a hidden gem from history, this legend is for you.

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-lhr8-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39003263_961033948683270_8273646164126363713_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=T4QYzO2EDLoQ7kNvgG6x9EJ&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-lhr8-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYB_UC2jehlidjlep86xq3t19__6nOC6QKYeimAcRd-Hdw&oe=6728A187)

With light gameplay elements, the focus is on the narrative. Dive into a story-rich experience lasting 1-4 hours ⏳, climb rigging, explore moonlit cabins 🌙, unearth hidden artefacts, and exercise your wit to become leader of the Red Flag Fleet.  

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-lhr6-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031579_801519894943640_3850714342256227051_n.png?_nc_cat=100&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=fAPpNvEfILcQ7kNvgE1kyru&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-lhr6-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCFKl07aqH5_a4UOfqnK-sTIS7kEhmEMPJVqyDnUUgnTQ&oe=67289466)

![{"height":231,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-lhr6-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031400_1653444588750690_8451663376835143463_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=lC-DjG0xWV4Q7kNvgE0muPL&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-lhr6-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAJLWL_aFwAXC1dhYPY0JWY4l5SjZ7ZhZrlfBVzKm0UsA&oe=6728C0D8)

Celebrated for its cinematic story and historical environments, this non-combat experience has earned critical acclaim, winning the Tribeca Storyscapes Award (2023) & the Raindance Discovery Award (2021) 🏆

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-lhr6-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75322595_315227141608157_6664541123259039926_n.png?_nc_cat=104&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=ot1yIfmGPeAQ7kNvgEKj43e&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-lhr6-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBQbA16QXTVbAbUL3BVUt0rNCD8AaOsQhiJsBoNAfeI3Q&oe=6728BD59)


![{"height":225,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-lhr8-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38974820_419365674368364_6471370540204954427_n.png?_nc_cat=106&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=VOjd2HYy1RAQ7kNvgFu9tAr&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-lhr8-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAe7GBd7uC4XibwHf5RP-f-UT_MzB-I7l5TOFlRCSOyAQ&oe=6728A370)

Experience the captivating performance from Hollywood actress Lucy Liu 🎭, who brings Cheng Shih's character to life, under the direction of critically acclaimed filmmaker and creative director Eloise Singer 🎬


![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-lhr6-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/57569455_779145490949371_5639970595016054333_n.png?_nc_cat=102&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=LuFYQKXi7VAQ7kNvgE9k3nt&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-lhr6-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAIkNmbhzdkw2PXKvS-xE1IrCS54rjug7Cw2p1Ng6q1Bw&oe=6728C62A)

![{"height":244,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-lhr8-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75593949_1392764491611640_7662168618929982906_n.png?_nc_cat=108&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=W5U151q-yGAQ7kNvgFz_1uB&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-lhr8-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAJbbZAHPW0wT2i2NZmf8FTcXmXdbGS0QxjujTxg5803A&oe=6728A197)

Are you ready to turn the tides of history? Let's see how well you fare as The Pirate Queen! 🏴‍☠️👑



![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-lhr6-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75251817_478868781249664_4666816330504461518_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=Fo6-WZi1jD8Q7kNvgGy6jJP&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-lhr6-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCd668T91ZEJqxCwOcIInoI1zTfHeP_tvQmbI7YLQZAyQ&oe=6728BD0C)
